fixed_buff: I personaggi di apertura avranno PS max, ATT e DIF aumentano del 20%.

mechanics.season_effect_text: After the above characters join your party, Max HP, ATK, and DEF are increased by 20%.

instructions: Act 3 · Jadeplume Terrorshroom
An evolved Fungus. When it is hit by Electro attacks and Catalyze reactions, it will accumulate Activation.
When it is hit by Pyro attacks, it will lose Activation progress. When it accumulates sufficient Activation, it will enter an Activated state.
An activated Jadeplume Terrorshroom will unleash more fearsome attacks until it becomes exhausted.
Act 6 · Emperor of Fire and Iron
An Armored Crablord that has survived for countless eons and surpassed almost all other Fontemer Aberrants.
The twin molten horns located high up on its body are Pyro-aligned organs that can unleash more vicious elemental attacks.
When the Armored Crablord unleashes certain attacks, its twin molten horns are closer to the ground, providing an opportunity to use Elemental Reactions.
Act 8 · Battle-Hardened Pipilpan Idol
During battle, the entity will create multiple hats and hide within one of them, then rapidly switch the positions of these hats.
After a certain number of switches, if the hat that conceals the entity takes Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged damage, it will temporarily halt.
Deal a certain amount of DMG to the hat concealing the entity to break all of the hats, causing the entity to reveal itself.
Act 10 · Radiant Moonfly
The strongest species, even among radiant beasts, whose 'Radiant Cocoon' displays still more obvious effects.
Quickly heal your HP to its maximum to escape from a Radiant Cocoon.
Radiant beasts possess many mysterious characteristics — rumors even circle that they can change their Elemental Type under the right conditions...
Extra Act 1 · Keep Fighting
Keep fighting until the countdown ends. End the stage with at least one character left standing to successfully complete the challenge.
Each opponent you defeat will take time off the countdown.
Once the challenge begins, all party members will continuously lose small amounts of HP.
Extra Act 2 · Battle-Hardened Primordial Bathysmal Vishap
The Battle-Hardened Primordial Bathysmal Vishap will attack using Cleansing Shower, and will also deploy Purification Fields.
Characters will lose a certain amount of Energy when damaged by Cleansing Shower or when stepping into a Purification Field.
If the character has insufficient Energy, they will lose HP instead.
